# Townie List
> Community directories of license-checked local pros, region by region. Live regions: Eugene & Springfield, Central Coast, South Coast, Oregon - licensed trades plus independent restaurants, coffee shops, services and a local events calendar in Eugene & Springfield.
> Listings are free; ratings come from Google and are checked monthly; licenses are verified against Oregon CCB records.
